svg.title: What the bot's panel shows
svg.text: Reading the panel: a boss fight, floor 16, the bot can't decide
What it is doing, and the floor.
Its five favourite moves, with the share of its preference each gets.
The highlighted one is the move it plays.
How sure it is: Very sure (top move 90%+), Fairly sure (60%+) or Unsure.
Network size and thinking time. 414 ms is slow for it: in elite and boss
fights, when unsure, it first tries its best moves on copies of the fight.
AI's own estimate: its gut feeling about the whole run, last 20 decisions
(higher: it thinks a Heart kill is more likely).
F9 pauses the bot, F8 hides the panel, F7 switches to a plainer view.
